page0.text:
"You sure took your sweet time coming home, huh!?"
"Guh...!"
The mask falls off the man who was her brother.
His sticky, plastic smile is gone without a trace.

page1.text:
"You traitor... You disgrace to the Matous...!"
He screams at her as he closes in.
The man glowers viciously at the girl, closing in with sluggish yet threatening steps.
"...!"
The girl twitches in fright.
She realizes that he's approaching her with hatred...and bloodlust.

page2.text:
"Ha! That's right, that's how you should be!
It doesn't matter how hard you try to act like a normal person.
You're a Matou woman. A lowly, cowardly has-been of a mage, no different from an emotionless doll!"
He roughly moves in.
"Mm...! No, stop—"
She retreats.
A long-lost feeling of superiority brings a smile to the man's face.

page3.text:
And that's why he fails to realize that the girl cowering in front of him
isn't obedient like she's always been.
The man is the only one who doesn't see that she's twisting away from him out of sheer revulsion and defiance.

page4.text:
"Hey, you're pretty feisty today... Uh-huh, I see. That's great!
Emiya must be in the dumps right now!"

page5.text:
"No... Stop it, stay away from me, Nii-san...!"
The girl does everything she can to push the threatening man away.

page6.text:
"...Huh?"
He stops.
His extended hand slightly dips, and he stares down at the girl as if encountering something alien.

page7.text:
"What'd you say? Hey, what'd you just say to me?"
His voice is shocked.
The girl gulps and works up the courage to look him in the eyes.

page8.text:
"I-I said to stay away from me. I'm not going to do what you say anymore.
...Senpai. Senpai accepted me. He said he'll protect me! I'm not your plaything. I'm...!"

page9.text:
The girl desperately tries to squirm out from under the man's oppressive shadow.
"...The hell?"
His voice is hollow.
He stares down at the cowering girl.

page10.text:
"What the hell!? What the hell!? Don't give me that shit!"
His temper explodes.

page11.text:
"Because of Emiya...!? You won't do what I say!?
Who the fuck do you think you are!? I'm your big brother, and I make the rules here! You just need to shut up and do what you're told, like always!"
The dam on his anger has broken, and there's no stopping it.
His mind can't take the shock of being defied by someone who's never turned on him before.

page12.text:
"Take that back, Sakura! You're mine, and no one else's! Know your place! You're a Matou woman! You don't have the right to say anything to me...!"
He doesn't know how to stop his anger.
"                      "
The girl glares at him reproachfully, with determination in her eyes.

page13.text:
He finds her gaze maddening.
He doesn't like being stared at so directly.
At the same time, he laughs at her powerless resistance.
He laughs.
He laughs.
The brother cackles in delight.

page14.text:
...
That's when she realizes, deep down
what he's thinking.
...No matter what,
he seems determined to ruin my life, just to ridicule me.

page15.text:
"Why..."
She whimpers.
Why is he always like this?
She's put up with so much, for so long.
She's lied to other people and even herself, trying to convince herself that she could still be happy someday.
She thought that she was happy just being at Senpai's house.

page16.text:
And yet...
Why can't he even let her have that?
...
...No, he isn't the only one.
She's always thought...
Always resented...
Why?
Why... Why does the world around me hate me this much?

page17.text:
...
She can't put any strength into her limbs.
She doesn't feel like resisting, and the man who calls himself her brother leers down at her.

page18.text:
"Ha...haha, hahahahahahahahahahaha!"
The girl absently stares up at the man making a smug, sinister expression.
"...I wish people like this didn't exist."
Eleven years.
She thinks something she's never thought before in all that time.

page19.text:
...
Something whips through the air.
The man who had been bearing down on her limps over.
There's a shower of fresh blood.
The girl rises and looks wordlessly at the man.

page20.text:
"...Ah."
He died instantly.
Something incredibly sharp hit him in the head,
There's some kind of line leading into his cranium.
Marked by flowing red liquid, the line reached his brain, but it's so thin that nothing leaks from the wound.

page21.text:
"...Oh."
She feels nothing as she looks down at it.
The shadow that killed her brother is swaying.
It's swaying as the gray sunlight illuminates it.
It's hers.
Her own sunlit shadow smoothly rises, quivering and swaying.

page22.text:
"...Aahh."
That's why she's the one who did it.
She killed her own brother.
She understands this, but she feels nothing.
She feels nothing.
Nothing.
Nothing.
Nothing.
Not hatred, nor fear, nor guilt, nor regret.
The only thought in her empty mind is how easy it was.

page23.text:
"...Ahhh, ahh..."
This feels familiar.
It isn't the first time.
She's dreamed about it plenty of times.
Maybe she learned by example because she saw it in her dreams. In her dreams.

page24.text:
"...Ah, ha."
She's not sure.
But she should have done this sooner.
If it wasn't going to feel like anything, then she should have done this a lot sooner.
"That's right," she thinks.
"...Heh...Heheh."
Her supposedly absent emotions whisper that it was fun.

page25.text:
It was fun.
It was fun.
It was fun...?
Not "it is fun," but "it was fun?"

page27.text:
Dream.
In a dream.
Oh, right. I'm not dreaming.
Yeah, that dream...

page28.text:
It isn't a dream.
The person that goes out every night and kills all the men who approach her is none other than herself.
She killed a lot of them.
So, so many.
I did it. I killed them all while laughing...!

page29.text:
"...Aha. Ahaha. Ahahaha."
It's hilarious.
If she doesn't laugh, she'll break.
She can't take this unless she laughs.
But the more she laughs, the more she falls apart, and her tears won't stop, and nothing starts to matter anymore.

page30.text:
"Haha! Ahaha, hahahahahahahahahaha!"
It's so funny that it makes her stomach hurt.
The more she laughs, the stupider she gets.
But it feels so good, and it comes out so easily.
Ahh, how silly, how absurd, how foolish she is...!

page31.text:
"...Heh. ...Heheh, ah."
Her smile twitches.
Sweet, twinkling chuckles escape her lips in place of her now-motionless brother.

page32.text:
...And then, after playing with her brother's body for a while, moving it around like a child playing house,
she finally gets up from the bed.
She stands in front of the mirror, looking at her blood-stained figure.
The shadow that's killed so many is standing behind her.

page33.text:
Her shadow.
Her dark self that's eaten dozens of people.
She tried so hard to control herself so that this wouldn't happen.
Someone stayed by her side so that this wouldn't happen.
She laughs scornfully.
There had never been any point to it from the beginning.

page34.text:
"...Oh. Looks like I've been slowly going crazy all along."
She twirls in front of the mirror.
A proud smile adorns her lips.
"Look, Senpai. I've always been broken."
She says in the same tone one might use to ask for a dance.

page35.text:
The girl's mind ended there.
It was replaced, to be precise.
Her subconscious which she had always kept a lid on simply emerged.

page36.text:
There's someone else she's speaking to, as well.
Behind the girl,
in the deep darkness, he reveals only his presence.

page37.text:
"...You've killed many people, Sakura."
The girl doesn't answer.
She doesn't even need to nod.

page38.text:
"You can no longer live as a human."
She doesn't answer.
That isn't worth responding to, either.

page39.text:
"Now, accept your shadow. Nobody can stop you now. Seize the Einzbern girl and acquire the Holy Grail. You have no other way to survive."
"Yes. As you say, Grandfather."
She nods quietly.
Does she anticipate the work to come, or
does she merely want to flee from him?
She doesn't know her own heart anymore.

page40.text:
All she knows is that the moment she accepted her shadow, all the pain she'd ever felt vanished like a dream.
...It creeps up her body.
Starting with her feet, the black mud coats her skin.
The pain becomes fire, and it burns her skin.
Like a curse.
Her pale skin turns into something else.

page41.text:
"Yes, with this..."
She won't lose to anyone ever again.
No one can stop her.
She knows for a fact that she's the strongest fighter in this war.
She'll defeat everyone who's threatened her, just as she always imagined.
